body:
## Context
Resolves #591 and #593.
- #591: `packages/cli/README.md` states in Resolution model that the dispatcher resolves package-local binaries without searching PATH, without carving out `review` (an `npx` passthrough to `adversarial-review`) or listing `adlc review` in Usage.
- #593: `adlc mcp-server` is missing from `packages/cli/lib/help.mjs` Usage and `packages/cli/README.md`, and `packages/cli/package.json` lacks an `exports` map declaring `./lib/mcp-server.mjs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `packages/cli/README.md` carves out `review` in Resolution model as an `npx` passthrough to external `adversarial-review` and lists `adlc review` and `adlc mcp-server` in Usage.
2. `packages/cli/lib/help.mjs` lists `adlc mcp-server` in Usage as the MCP stdio server entrypoint.
3. `packages/cli/package.json` declares `exports` including `.`, `./lib/mcp-server.mjs`, and `./package.json`, with tests in `packages/cli/test/dispatch.test.mjs`.
title: cli: document review npx passthrough in README and adlc mcp-server in help/README (#591, #593)
